name: v1
description: Mouse V1 profile with only well-sourced entries filled from the stub (original untouched). Rows without a verified number remain TODO. verified=true = number read in the primary paper (text/abstract); model assumptions flagged. See VERIFICATION_NOTES.md.

comments._profile: Interneuron classes need a model that labels them; with only excitatory/inhibitory labels map "inhibitory" to one class or add a generic "interneuron" type.

literature.reference: Billeh YN, Cai B, Gratiy SL, et al. 2020 Neuron 106(3):388-403, doi 10.1016/j.neuron.2020.01.040, PMID 32142648 (read in bioRxiv v2 text, 10.1101/662189)
literature.quote: "with an 85%:15% fraction for excitatory and inhibitory neurons"
literature.notes: Model parameter. Only about the first third of the preprint was read.

literature.reference: Schneider-Mizell CM, Bodor AL, Brittain D, et al. 2025 Nature 640(8058):448-458, "Inhibitory specificity from a connectomic census of mouse visual cortex", doi 10.1038/s41586-024-07780-8, PMID 40205209, PMC11981935
literature.source_tissue: mouse VISp L2/3 pyramidal M-types L2b (3,510) and L2a (4,532), EM, complete dendrites
literature.quote: "L2a had a 29% higher overall dendritic length (L2a, 4,532 um; L2b, 3,510 um)"
literature.notes: Layer 2 only. Do not use the 1.475 mm EM median of Turner et al. 2022 Cell 185:1082 (PMC9337909) as a total: its arbors are only about 34% complete (lower bound).

literature.reference: Schneider-Mizell CM, Bodor AL, Brittain D, et al. 2025 Nature 640(8058):448-458, "Inhibitory specificity from a connectomic census of mouse visual cortex", doi 10.1038/s41586-024-07780-8, PMID 40205209, PMC11981935
literature.source_tissue: mouse VISp L2/3 pyramidal (M-types L2a/L2b), serial-section EM, complete dendrites
literature.notes: Two layer-2 types only. Neocortex mean 8,200 synapses/neuron (Schuz & Palm 1989 abstract, areas 8/6/17) is higher: different method and layers.

literature.unit: fraction of GABAergic (GAD67-GFP) cells, not of all neurons
literature.reference: Pfeffer CK, Xue M, He M, Huang ZJ, Scanziani M 2013 Nat Neurosci 16(8):1068-1076, "Inhibition of inhibition in visual cortex: the logic of connections between molecularly distinct interneurons", doi 10.1038/nn.3446, PMID 23817549, PMC3729586
literature.source_tissue: mouse V1, Cre x tdTomato x GAD67-GFP, fixed tissue
literature.quote: "Pvalb-Cre, Sst-Cre and VIP-Cre cells made up 36%+/-0.5, 30%+/-1.5 and 17%+/-1 of the GAD67-GFP population"
literature.notes: Immunolabel alternative from Gonchar 2007 Table 2: PV 39 +/- 6, SOM 23 +/- 7, VIP 11 +/- 3 % of GABAergic (PV = 0.39). Multiply by the inhibitory fraction (about 0.15-0.20) for a share of all neurons. Three Cre lines cover ~80% of GABAergic cells.

literature.reference: Gonchar Y, Wang Q, Burkhalter A 2008 (online 2007) Front Neuroanat 1:3, "Multiple distinct subtypes of GABAergic neurons in mouse visual cortex identified by triple immunostaining", doi 10.3389/neuro.05.003.2007, PMID 18958197, PMC2525923, Table 2
literature.source_tissue: adult (>90 d) mouse V1, PV immunolabel, optical disector, fixed tissue
literature.notes: Single-label counts from different sections. GABA total in the same table is 51,785 +/- 5,554 /mm^3 (about 1/3 of the 155,426 total-neuron density above): do not combine the two to compute fractions. Keller 2018 quotes much lower Cre-reporter counts (Kim et al. 2017: 4,886 PV, 5,028 SST, 2,964 VIP /mm^3; SECONDARY, primary not opened): expect a 3-4x method spread.

literature.prep: EM, partial axons (50-75% of output captured)
literature.notes: Number verified; mapping PeriTC=PV is the authors' "not a one-to-one match", so marked unverified for the PV label. Lower bound.

literature.reference: Herculano-Houzel S, Watson CRR, Paxinos G 2013 Front Neuroanat 7:35, "Distribution of neurons in functional areas of the mouse cerebral cortex reveals quantitatively different cortical zones", doi 10.3389/fnana.2013.00035, PMID 24155697, PMC3800983
literature.source_tissue: adult Swiss mouse V1 (all neurons), isotropic fractionator
literature.prep: fixed tissue, nuclei counts / dissected volume
literature.quote: "V1 is the cortical area with the largest neuronal density (155,426 neurons/mm3)"
literature.notes: V1 thickness 0.583 mm; 90,650 neurons/mm^2 under surface. Keller 2018 Table 1 lists other visual-area values 92,400-214,000 (mean 164,000 +/- 50,000), SECONDARY.

literature.notes: 3-area mean, not V1-specific; about 1.7x lower than the V1 isotropic-fractionator value (method spread).

literature.unit: probability (Gaussian-fit peak, L2/3, adjusted for slicing; 95% CI 0.57-0.99)
literature.reference: Campagnola L, Seeman SC, et al. 2022 Science 375(6585):eabj5861, "Local connectivity and synaptic dynamics in mouse and human neocortex", doi 10.1126/science.abj5861, PMID 35271334, PMC9970277
literature.source_tissue: adult mouse VISp acute slice (mean age 46 d), multipatch, L2/3 pyramidal -> Pvalb
literature.quote: "the pyramidal to Pvalb connection in L2/3 (pmax=0.79 [0.57, 0.99] 95% CI)"
literature.notes: pmax is the peak connection probability at short intersomatic distance (sigma ~125 um), not a patch-average probability, hence comparable=false. L5 IT -> Pvalb 0.22 (0.12-0.35).

literature.reference: Campagnola L, Seeman SC, et al. 2022 Science 375(6585):eabj5861, "Local connectivity and synaptic dynamics in mouse and human neocortex", doi 10.1126/science.abj5861, PMID 35271334, PMC9970277

literature.notes: Vip -> E 0.11 (0.03-0.26) from the same sentence. Pfeffer 2013: L2/3 pyramid pairs Pvalb->pyr 12/12, Sst->pyr 12/12, VIP->pyr 4/32 connected (25-100 um).
